closed_forms.convention_D_row_cap: The last two forms carry the factor (A z - q^3), whose root is exactly the production convention D, z = q^3/(q^2+1) = q^3/A. So under D both vanish IDENTICALLY -- equivalently the Wenzl level is Q^r = q^4 = Q^2, r = 2, and Wenzl's row cap (s_{alpha,r} = 0 for l(alpha) > r; Orellana, Crelle 508 (1999) 157-178, p. 5) kills every lambda with three or more rows. tr_M then factors through the two-row (Temperley-Lieb) quotient and only (4,), (3,1), (2,2) carry weight. Convention C sat at r ~ 2.5995, not an integer, and capped nothing. Asserted at run time; bean qou-fq0f.
closed_forms.notation: A = q^2+1, B = q^4+q^2+1, C = q^4+1 (the wedderburn4 genericity factors h2, h3, h4)
